dominant_strengths: Faithful Apple-native typographic voice with confident SF-style headline weight and balanced tracking at large display sizes
Clean translucent nav with proper hierarchy (Overview/Tech Specs/visionOS/Buy) preserving the marketing-page conventions
Restrained palette and generous whitespace let the headline breathe in classic Apple product-page rhythm
dominant_weaknesses: Captured mid-scroll: top headline is clipped and a pale beige interior photo dominates the lower half, breaking compositional integrity
Two zones fight — airy white type block above versus warm-toned room photo below — with no transitional gradient or anchor
Essentially a replica of Apple's marketing page; design distinctiveness and innovation are near zero beyond execution fidelity
fix_priorities: Capture at a stable scroll anchor so the headline ('The era of spatial computing is here.') is fully framed, not bisected
Introduce a smoother transition (gradient, parallax masking, or section break) between the white type panel and the interior photo
Add a distinguishing creative gesture — bespoke type treatment, depth cue, or product motif — to move beyond pure homage
Tighten vertical rhythm so the lower image hero has its own headline/CTA rather than reading as orphaned scenery
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral is muted by the awkward mid-scroll crop, behavioral is solid via familiar Apple nav patterns, reflective is weak because the work mirrors an existing artifact rather than asserting a viewpoint.
rationale.intent_fit: It plausibly recreates an Apple Vision Pro scroll state, but the framing crops the key headline and exposes a seam between sections, undercutting the brief's polish.
